# Compactor Full Technical Specification for AI Agents

> **Author:** Kuber Bassi (https://kuberbassi.com)  
> **Application:** https://compactor.kuberbassi.com  
> **Repository:** https://github.com/kuberbassi/compactor

Compactor is a privacy-first, client-side media processing suite built with React 19, TypeScript, WebAssembly, FFmpeg.wasm, pdf-lib, HTML5 Canvas APIs, and IndexedDB. Every tool runs entirely inside the user's browser with zero server-side file processing.

---

# Architecture

## Privacy First

- 100% client-side execution
- Zero file uploads
- No cloud processing
- No user accounts required
- Files never leave the browser
- Works completely offline after initial caching (PWA)

## Core Technologies

- React 19
- TypeScript
- WebAssembly (WASM)
- FFmpeg.wasm
- pdf-lib
- pdfjs-dist
- docx
- Mammoth.js
- Tesseract.js OCR
- ImageTracerJS
- HTML5 Canvas API
- IndexedDB
- Vite
- Progressive Web App (PWA)

## Performance

- Lazy-loaded modules
- Browser memory processing
- Hardware-accelerated browser APIs when available
- SharedArrayBuffer support via COOP/COEP
- Zero server-side rendering

---

# PDF Tools

## Edit PDF (#pdf-edit)

Features

- Add text, rectangles, circles, lines, and arrows
- Move, resize, rotate, style, reorder, hide, or remove layers
- Export a flattened PDF locally
- Responsive phone and tablet workspace

---

## Redact PDF (#pdf-redact)

Features

- Blackout, whiteout, or labelled redaction boxes
- Exported pages are rasterized at high resolution so covered source content is permanently removed
- Files remain inside the browser

---

## Page Organizer (#pdf-organize)

Features

- Drag & drop page ordering
- Rotate pages
- Delete pages
- Extract selected pages
- Thumbnail preview

---

## Merge PDF (#pdf-merge)

Features

- Combine multiple PDF files
- Drag reorder before merging
- Preserve document quality

---

## Split PDF (#pdf-split)

Features

- Split by page range
- Extract selected pages
- Export multiple PDFs

---

## Crop Margins (#pdf-crop-tool)

Features

- Remove white margins
- Crop all pages
- Custom crop percentages

---

## Compress PDF (#pdf-compress)

Features

- Reduce PDF size
- Optimize embedded images
- Preserve text clarity

---

Document filters

## Markdown Workspace (#pdf-word-to-pdf)

Features

- Markdown rendering
- Live edit, split, and preview modes
- README, meeting notes, proposal, and API templates
- Download editable Markdown
- Code block formatting
- Preview-matched PDF generation that preserves visible fonts, colors, tables, code blocks, and wrapping
- PDF pages are image-based to prioritize visual fidelity over selectable text

---

## PDF to Markdown (#pdf-to-word)

Features

- Text extraction
- Markdown output
- Searchable text preservation

# Conversion Tools

## Verified File Converter (#universal-converter)

Features

- Only engine-backed source and target pairs are enabled
- Automatic format recommendations
- Browser-based conversion
- Zero uploads
- Invalid PDF and DOCX signatures are rejected
- Scanned PDF pages without a text layer automatically use private in-browser English OCR
- Unsupported targets remain visible only where useful and are dimmed and disabled

Supported source formats

- Documents: PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown
- Data: CSV, JSON
- Images: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, BMP, SVG
- Audio: MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, M4A, OGG, Opus, WebA
- Video: MP4, WebM, MOV, AVI, MKV, FLV

Document conversion paths

- PDF to DOCX with either visual layout preservation for images and formatting or editable text using embedded text/OCR; PDF to TXT also supports OCR
- DOCX to PDF, TXT, or HTML
- TXT and Markdown to PDF, DOCX, or HTML

Reliability policy

- A format is not listed as a supported source unless at least one implemented conversion path exists.
- A target is enabled only when an installed engine handles that exact source-target pair.
- Compactor never creates a result by merely changing the source extension or MIME type.
- OCR output is editable text and may require proofreading for handwriting, unusual fonts, low-resolution scans, complex tables, or languages other than English.

---

# Security

Compactor processes every file entirely inside the browser.

No uploaded files.

No analytics on file contents.

No cloud processing.

No server-side transcoding.

No permanent storage of user files.

---

# Browser Support

Modern Chromium browsers

- Google Chrome
- Microsoft Edge
- Brave
- Opera

Mozilla Firefox

Safari (feature availability depends on browser APIs)

---

# Progressive Web App

Compactor supports installation as a Progressive Web App.

Features

- Installable
- Offline caching
- Native-like experience
- Fast repeat launches
